concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑005 requires reporting the speed‑up factor relative to the ACE‑Ego‑0 baseline (5 min CPU per hour of video). Task T013 only records raw CPU minutes and RAM usage and asserts absolute limits; it never computes or logs the comparative speed‑up, so the required artifact for SC‑005 is never produced.

The specification’s Edge Cases mandate imputation of missing static‑feature values with the dataset mean (or segment exclusion if imputation fails). No task in the list implements this imputation/exclusion logic, yet downstream tasks (e.g., T005 residual analysis) assume a complete `static_features.csv`. This missing producer creates a hidden dependency and violates the functional requirement.
